title: Hand Bag

sources.title: Impress the Murder Tribunal
markers: | description = Impress the Murder Tribunal is a sub-quest of the quest Get Orin's Netherstone in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It is started automatically after entering Wyrm's Rock Fortress and long resting, or by entering the sewers for the first time.

summary: Open the bag taken from Dolor to collect four victims’ hands. Offer a hand as proof at the Murder Tribunal.

fields.Contents: Alexander Rainforest’s, Duke Stelmane’s, Father Lorgan’s, and Franc Peartree’s hands.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
